notes.ASCII_WORD: review candidate only; proper names, acronyms, codes and product names may be valid
notes.ASCII_ONLY: triage bucket only; proper names/titles/model identifiers and explicit English fallbacks may be valid
notes.ASCII_MIXED: triage bucket only; normal Japanese labels may legitimately contain brands/acronyms
notes.ASCII_SUSPICIOUS: priority review bucket for machine-composed Japanese/English seams or untranslated qualifier words; never auto-fix from this signal
notes.SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE_HINT: high-signal Simplified-Chinese-form heuristic only; shared Japanese characters are intentionally excluded; never auto-fix from this signal
notes.RAW_ENGLISH_WRAPPER: semantic review required; this script never auto-fixes it
